Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: one vocabulary illustration for a bilingual learning app for children aged 7–10.
Style: warm, simple hand-painted gouache with light colored-pencil contours and subtle paper grain. Calm, thoughtful storybook art, clear readable actions, gently expressive faces, natural child proportions, no glossy 3D or exaggerated cartoon faces. Where two children appear, use a short dark-haired child in a muted coral top and a wavy brown-haired child in a sage-green top; keep both equally important. Human skin and hair colors remain natural.
Palette: warm paper #F8F5ED, deep green pencil #293D36, pale sage #DDE6DB, muted coral #CB765D; restrained warm ochre/wood/brass accents when the actual objects require them.
Composition: landscape 4:3, designed for an 800×600 WebP learning card. One clear, large scene with a quiet warm cream background and breathing room; keep all meaningful faces, hands and objects inside the frame. Minimal environment, easy to understand at a small size.
Constraints: no written words, letters, numerals, labels, captions, watermark, logo, decorative border or UI. Draw only the people and objects needed for the described scene. Hands and object contacts must be coherent. Depict kind, ordinary everyday situations.
